english.title: Prevent person from appearing before / answering a question of an inspector
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) prevented another person, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..) from

(A)_[appearing before an inspector exercising a power under]_
(B)_[answering a question to which an inspector required an answer by virtue of]_

section 115(3) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990
english.legislation: Contrary to section 118(1)(h) and (7) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 3 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
